name: Lightlock
disable: DC 27 Thievery check (master) to disrupt some of the hidden runes that focus the trap's energies, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 25) or any spell with the Light trait to counteract the trap
reset: The lightlock takes 1 minute to restore its energy, after which it can be triggered again.

items.name: Freeze the Awful Light
items.text:
Trigger A creature carrying a light source ends their turn in area F8

---

Effect The walls fire beams of chilling dark fog at the triggering creature, who takes 10d6 cold damage (DC 25 basic Fortitude save save). The beams also attempt to counteract any light source the triggering creature carries. Non-magical light sources of 7th level or less are automatically extinguished. Against other light sources, the lightlock casts a 4th-rank Dispel Magic spell with a counteract modifier of +14 to attempt to counteract the light.

text: The strange fog layer on the walls swirls and churns, then suddenly fires several beams of dark mist into the room.
